board.material: FR4 exact grade and CTI unknown

HV_CROSS.basis: Own experimental routing default; TI SLUP419 400V/PD2/groupIII 4mm creepage and 4kV/PD2 3mm clearance examples as context. HF and exact product-standard assessment open.

OUTPUT_CROSS.basis: Own engineering target for conditional 145V output; no standard clause asserted.

LOCAL_FUNCTIONAL.basis: Local <=15V differential only, manufacturing/assembly proposal. No safety insulation credit.

EDGE_SETBACK.basis: Own fixture/handling reservation; not human touch protection.

EXTERNAL_BOUNDARY_RESERVATION.basis: Own space reservation only. Basic/reinforced protection and actual fixture boundary not qualified.

exceptions_open.closure: Exact differential/package evidence plus local route review or geometry/package change.
Component-contained insulation and PCB escape assessment; no blanket waiver.
Exact repetitive/impulse stress and component/package/PCB review.
Input-output package surface/PCB assessment; isolation test rating alone insufficient.

barrier_record_example.side_b: defined fixture metal/access region, geometry pending
barrier_record_example.evidence: README.md source context plus future exact geometry assessment
barrier_record_example.warning: Incomplete proposal intentionally cannot be used as a passing approved barrier record.

manual_geometry_checks: All copper layers, vias, pads, fillets and zone edges counted
Surface paths around board edges, holes and slots inspected
Solid dielectric paths not equated with surface creepage
No low-voltage inference from a net name or small local differential
Rule precedence and every local package exception checked against actual PCB
